name: Chapter 1: The Living World
description: Diversity, nomenclature, binomial names, taxonomy and the taxonomic hierarchy

name: Chapter 2: Biological Classification
description: Five kingdoms, Monera to Fungi, viruses, viroids, prions and lichens

name: Chapter 3: Plant Kingdom
description: Classification systems, algae, bryophytes, pteridophytes, gymnosperms and angiosperms

name: Chapter 4: Animal Kingdom
description: Basis of classification, every non-chordate phylum, chordates and the vertebrate classes

name: Chapter 5: Morphology of Flowering Plants
description: Root, stem, leaf, inflorescence, flower, fruit, seed, floral formula and Solanaceae

name: Chapter 6: Anatomy of Flowering Plants
description: Tissue systems, stomata, vascular bundles, and T.S. of dicot and monocot root, stem and leaf

name: Chapter 7: Structural Organisation in Animals
description: Tissues, organs and organ systems, and the morphology and anatomy of the frog

name: Chapter 8: Cell: The Unit of Life
description: Cell theory, prokaryotic cells, and every eukaryotic organelle with its NCERT diagram

name: Chapter 9: Biomolecules
description: Chemical analysis of tissues, metabolites, proteins, polysaccharides, nucleic acids and enzymes

name: Chapter 10: Cell Cycle and Cell Division
description: Cell cycle phases, G0, mitosis stages, cytokinesis, meiosis I and II, and their significance

name: Chapter 11: Photosynthesis in Higher Plants
description: Early experiments, pigments, light reaction, Z scheme, chemiosmosis, Calvin cycle, C4 pathway, photorespiration, limiting factors

name: Chapter 12: Respiration in Plants
description: Gas exchange in plants, glycolysis, fermentation, Krebs cycle, ETS, ATP balance sheet, amphibolic pathway, RQ

name: Chapter 13: Plant Growth and Development
description: Growth phases and rates, differentiation, plasticity, and the five plant growth regulators

name: Chapter 14: Breathing and Exchange of Gases
description: Respiratory organs, human respiratory system, breathing mechanism, lung volumes, gas exchange and transport, regulation, disorders

name: Chapter 15: Body Fluids and Circulation
description: Blood, blood groups, clotting, lymph, circulatory patterns, human heart, cardiac cycle, ECG, double circulation, disorders

name: Chapter 16: Excretory Products and their Elimination
description: Nitrogenous wastes, excretory organs, kidney and nephron, urine formation, counter current, regulation, micturition, disorders

name: Chapter 17: Locomotion and Movement
description: Types of movement, muscles, sarcomere, sliding filament theory, human skeleton, joints and disorders

name: Chapter 18: Neural Control and Coordination
description: Neural system, neuron structure, nerve impulse, synapse, and parts of the human brain

name: Chapter 19: Chemical Coordination and Integration
description: Endocrine glands and their hormones, disorders, hormones of heart, kidney and gut, and mechanism of hormone action
